fichas.title: Patient Rooms and Care Unit
fichas.summary: Guidance for patient-room layout, furnishing, wall protection, and bed transport, accompanied by a care-unit plan for a 337-bed hospital. Beds should be accessible on three sides; the built-in cupboard should open without moving the bed or side table. The plan labels several care-unit types, including intermediate-care, general-care, and baby-and-children’s-care wards.
spaces: Single, two-bed, and three-bed patient rooms
furniture_equipment: Supply rail for air, gas, and lighting
